The application uses the system `ssh` binary via `exec.Command` instead of the library for SSH tunneling. As per rule: IF NO explicit call is found, probability is 0.01 (1%).

Vulnerability requires an SSH server configured for GSSAPI authentication. Lazydocker is a client-side TUI and does not implement an SSH server or call GSSAPI-related functions from `golang.org/x/crypto/ssh`. As per rule: IF NO explicit call is found, probability is 0.01 (1%). Difference (39%) exceeds the 20% tolerance.
No explicit calls to `ForwardToAgent` or `ServeAgent` from `golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/agent` found in the codebase. As per rule: IF NO explicit call is found, probability is 0.01 (1%).
